messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected: cross-region routing anomaly affecting steer and pinning logic. Alert threshold breached in eu-west and us-east at 2026-05-18T20:12:14Z. Auto-escalation -> #incidents.
Alex (oncall): I'm on it. seeing a spike in cross-region RTT and an increase in 5xx from proxied routes. tagging eng-sre.
Raj: looking at routing-control logs now. there's a sudden policy rollout at 20:10 UTC that touched the geo-steer operator. Operator ID: geo-op-7f3.
Emma: I can confirm a policy diff was applied: accidental tweak to fallback weighting that heavily favors us-east for eu-west probes. probable mis-configured default.
Alex (oncall): TLDR: policy change -> lockstep weight flip -> many eu-west clients pinned to us-east -> increased latency + transient 502/504. Customer-facing errors starting ~20:12.
Priya: paging product/eng-plat to confirm whether rollout was scheduled. @Raj any author info in change?
Raj: change submitted by deploy-bot via script `auto-rollout.sh` (id 78321). user field is empty. suspect automation bug.
Zack: traces show KV cache misses when cross-region TTL mismatch occurs, so tokenized sessions hit cold state -> 502 bursts.
Alex (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) immediate rollback of policy change 2) pin-shadow disable for eu-west -> prefer local endpoints 3) increase geo-probe aggressiveness to detect correct latency.
Emma: rolling back now: `redwoodctl policy rollback --revision=geo-op-7f3@prev`
Emma: (runs) rollback accepted, returning to revision geo-op-7f3@rev4.
oncall-bot: deploy-bot: rollback job 8921 started by Emma at 2026-05-18T20:16:03Z.
Alex (oncall): flip completed? status?
Emma: rollback finished, diff shows weights restored. monitoring for recovery.
Priya: updating CS: initial impacted customers: acme-marketing, quickdocs, beta-shop. CS-Bot will fire notifications.
CS-Bot: Sending incident notification to customers whose traffic deviated > 30% between 20:10-20:20 UTC. Template: "We observed routing disruptions impacting latency; mitigation in progress."
Raj: telemetry: RTT median for eu-west -> us-east dropped back to baseline at 20:22, but some 502s persisted on long-tail sessions.
Zack: discovered that some long-lived pins were incorrectly tagged with region=us-east during the automation run. need a fix to pin reconciliation job.
Alex (oncall): temporary workaround: run pin-reconcile with `--force-clear` on impacted shards to reassign correct region tags. I will run a cautious batch.
Emma: running reconcile on shard eu-west-3: `pinctl reconcile --shard eu-west-3 --mode dry-run` then `--apply` if clear.
Emma: dry-run indicates ~2.1k pins with stale region tag; proceeding to apply in 5m windows.
Raj: also pushing a patch to the operator to validate weight delta > threshold before rollout to prevent wide flips. I'll open PR and backport to release branch.
oncall-bot: Pager escalation: Priya now oncall for secondary. Handoff ETA 20:30 UTC.
Priya: I'm taking secondary. Alex, handing off tracking and customer comms to me. Please drop any troubleshooting notes.
Alex (oncall): note: DNS TTLs were 30s for geo-stub; after rollback we should bump to 45s temporarily to reduce churn while reconcile runs.
Priya: agreed. I'll coordinate with eng-infra to update: `dnsctl set-ttl geo-stub 45`
Zack: after reconcile apply, we should run a scoped cache flush for CDN edges to avoid clients hitting stale pins: `cdnctl purge --tags region:eu-west`
Raj: PR for operator gate is up: https://git.internal/r/redwood/ops/PR-412. I'll link postmortem later.
Alex (oncall): impact summary for postmortem: root cause = automation script triggered policy rollout with missing validation -> weight flip favored remote region -> pin tagging bug left some sessions pinned incorrectly -> increased latency and 5xx for subset of customers.
Priya: customer impact: 3 customers with >30% latency increase, 12 accounts with intermittent errors, no data loss reported. Severity: SEV2 (service degradation with customer impact).
Emma: monitoring: error rates back to baseline at 20:31 for most; long tail resolved by 20:40 after reconcile & CDN purge.
Alex (oncall): created incident ticket INC-2026-0456, linking logs, traces, and PR. owners: Raj (root cause & operator patch), Emma (rollback & recon), Priya (customer comms & follow-up).
Priya: immediate follow-ups: schedule postmortem meeting tomorrow 15:00 UTC, draft external customer note, confirm automation runbook updates.
Raj: I'll add unit tests to prevent empty user field triggers and add a canary gate (5% rollouts).
Emma: adding playbook step: preflight validation step output required before any geo-steer rollout.
Alex (oncall): thanks team. keeping channel open for 1hr for any lingering alerts. please add any logs or reproductions here.
Zack: leaving notes: command snippets used during incident:
```
redwoodctl policy rollback --revision=geo-op-7f3@prev
pinctl reconcile --shard eu-west-3 --mode dry-run
pinctl reconcile --shard eu-west-3 --apply --batch=5m
dnsctl set-ttl geo-stub 45
cdnctl purge --tags region:eu-west
```
Priya: received, will include in postmortem. closing handoff to Raj for long-term fix.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-0456 status: mitigated. Monitor window open until 2026-05-18T21:15:00Z.
Alex (oncall): marking initial thread resolved, will add timeline entries to ticket. good job everyone. :thumbsup:
